annotations.title: DOT audit readiness: driver qualification file, medical card, Clearinghouse, MCS-150, UCR and Form 2290 dates checked against the federal rules (signed)

description: DOT audit readiness check for small US trucking companies and the agents that keep their files. Send dates only, never names or licence numbers: for up to 25 drivers the hire date, application, pre-hire MVR and employer-history dates, road test, last annual MVR and review, medical card expiry, Clearinghouse pre-employment and annual queries and licence expiry; for heavy vehicles the month each was first used (Form 2290); the UCR years registered; and optionally a USDOT number. Returns per item: overdue, missing, due_soon, ok, open, check, not_required or not_confirmed, with the due date, the federal rule (49 CFR 382.701, 390.19T, 391.11-391.51; 49 CFR 367; IRS Form 2290 instructions) and a link, a dated reminder list, the MCS-150 biennial update read from the public FMCSA census when a USDOT number is sent, the UCR fee bracket, sources with dates and a signed record. The eCFR is read live: if a cited section was amended after these rules were written the answer says not_confirmed. Errors: isError true with {ok: false, error} for bad input (400; unknown fields are refused and never echoed), a request over 24000 bytes (413) or the hourly limit (429). Free, no sign-up: 120 checks an hour per address. No model, nothing stored. It checks dates, not documents, and is not legal or tax advice.

as_of.description: Date to check against, 2020-01-01 to 2035-12-31 (default: today, UTC). Other dates: 1970 to 2045.

dot_number.description: USDOT number, digits only, up to 8. Optional: adds the MCS-150 update and UCR bracket from the public census.

drivers.description: One object per driver, dates only (YYYY-MM-DD). Answers come back by position (driver 1, 2, ...).

cdl.description: Holds a CDL and is subject to drug and alcohol testing (default true).

road_test_equivalent.description: A licence or road test certificate was accepted instead of a road test (49 CFR 391.33).

vehicles.description: Commercial motor vehicles owned or operated, for the fee bracket (else the census power units).

filed_on.description: Date the Form 2290 for that period was filed, if it was.

first_used_month.description: Month first used on public highways (YYYY-MM).

window_days.description: How far ahead counts as due soon (default 30).
